_note: WHAT THE PLAYER CAN DO ON HIS TURN (group N, 2026-10-03; Yannick, after Baldur's Gate 3: the actions gathered by category in a wheel, a target chosen explicitly, the chance to hit and the damage shown before the blow). One row an action and one a category, in the wheel's order. A new weapon, spell or item is a row here and nothing else: 'kind' is what the turn does (strike, cast, wait - 'use' for items, later), 'weapon' what it strikes with ('held': the sword in his hand, or his fists; 'bow': the bow on his back), 'needs' what he must carry or know for it to be offered at all. core/rules/action_rules.gd reads it; the wheel (view/action_wheel.gd) draws it.
_categories_note: The wheel's segments, clockwise from the top. 'items' is there before there is an item to put in it: potions come with the inventory's consumables, as a row of 'actions' with kind 'use'.
